statement: The mutant pass asks whether test/mcp.test.mjs can notice tools/mcp.mjs breaking. The server was copied into a scratch directory with its imports pointed back at the tree and a probe added; the unmutated copy ran the suite first as the control: 15 of 15 tests passed in 2487.178 ms and the probe wrote 0 lines. Then 16 copies each carried one deliberate defect (a notification answered, the wrong parse error code, noise on stdout, a nonzero exit, a lost log line, an unknown tool or bad input let through, a footer, knowledge, verdict or status field falsified, --state ignored, the protocol version ignored, a blank line answered, the verdict name unchecked), and each defect's own code wrote a probe line when it ran. 16 of 16 were killed (a test that passed on the control failed), 0 survived and 0 never executed, so every defect this table names is one the suite catches. The provider env refusal is not mutated: removing it would let a call reach a model endpoint, and this pass runs model off.
